title: Data Engineering for AI
tagline: Move, store, clean, and version the data that models learn from: SQL, Parquet, DuckDB, pipelines, labeling, and LLM-scale dataset curation.
prereqs: Python & Math for AI (Python and pandas basics). Machine Learning helps for the feature and labeling steps.

steps.title: What data engineers do
steps.why: How raw data becomes something analysts and models can use.

steps.title: SQL basics
steps.why: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and JOIN: the language of data.

steps.title: ETL vs ELT
steps.why: Two ways to build pipelines, and why AI teams care.

steps.title: Warehouse, lake, and lakehouse
steps.why: Where data lives, and the trade-offs of each design.

steps.title: The Parquet file format
steps.why: Columnar files make big datasets small and fast to read.

steps.title: Query files with DuckDB
steps.why: Run fast SQL on local CSV and Parquet with no server.

steps.title: Fast dataframes with Polars
steps.why: A quicker, lazier alternative to pandas for big tables.

steps.title: What Apache Spark is
steps.why: How data gets split across many machines when one is not enough.

steps.title: Schedule pipelines with Airflow
steps.why: DAGs, tasks, and schedules for jobs that run every day.

steps.title: Validate data with Pandera
steps.why: Catch bad rows before they silently break training.

steps.title: Version data with DVC
steps.why: Track datasets like code so experiments stay reproducible.

steps.title: Feature stores
steps.why: Serve the same features in training and in production.

steps.title: Label data with Label Studio
steps.why: Annotate text and images to build your own training set.

steps.title: Find near-duplicates with MinHash
steps.why: Shingling and LSH spot repeated documents at scale.

steps.title: How an LLM dataset is built
steps.why: FineWeb's filtering and deduplication of web data, step by step.

projects: Turn a public CSV dataset into partitioned Parquet files and answer five questions about it with DuckDB SQL.
Write an Airflow DAG that downloads a daily dataset, validates it with Pandera, and saves a versioned copy with DVC.
Deduplicate a few thousand scraped web pages with MinHash and report how many near-duplicates you removed.
